description: Configuration of the risk models for candidates 1 to 5 and of the detection model for lung toxicity. Every value states its basis: a literature value or an assumption of this project. This file is kept separate from the engine configuration on purpose, so that the risk model does not read the parameters that generated the data.

severe_toxicity_90d.description: Candidate 1. Logistic model. The regimen rate is the risk of the reference patient; odds ratios shift the risk for patient factors.

reference_patient.basis: haemoglobin and albumin: medians in Extermann et al. (2012), 12.3 g/dl and 3.8 g/dl; the others are assumptions

adt_docetaxel.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS, placebo arm

chemotherapy_single_agent.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, physician's choice arm

per_10_years_of_age.basis: assumption. Extermann et al. (2012) found no effect of age among patients of 70 or older once the regimen was taken into account (odds ratio 0.99 to 1.01 per year); Lyman et al. (2011) found 1.30 for 65 or older for neutropenic events.

ecog_2_or_higher.basis: assumption; performance status is a selection criterion in Conroy et al. (2023) and Sohal et al. (2020), and Extermann et al. (2012) found an odds ratio of 1.41 per class of ECOG 0, 1 to 2 and 3 to 4 for non-haematological toxicity

per_impaired_ga_domain.basis: assumption; with the age effect it gives about 72% severe toxicity for the average GAP70+ patient, who had 71% under usual care (Mohile et al., 2021)

per_g_dl_haemoglobin_below_reference.basis: Extermann et al. (2012), Table 2: odds ratio 0.90 per g/dl for non-haematological toxicity, adjusted for the regimen, not statistically significant (P = .12)

per_10_g_l_albumin_below_reference.basis: Extermann et al. (2012), Table 2: odds ratio 0.74 per g/dl for non-haematological toxicity, adjusted for the regimen, not statistically significant (P = .22)

reduced_starting_dose.basis: assumption; in GAP70+ more patients started with reduced intensity in the arm with less toxicity (Mohile et al., 2021), and a planned dose intensity below 85% halved the odds of neutropenic events in Lyman et al. (2011)

categories.basis: assumption; 0.7 is close to the 71% of the usual-care arm in GAP70+ (Mohile et al., 2021), 0.5 close to the 51% of its intervention arm

thresholds.basis: Lyman et al. (2011): planned relative dose intensity below 85%

ild.description: Candidate 2. Proportional hazards model: risk = 1 - (1 - r0)^HR, with r0 the risk of a patient without risk factors and HR the product of the hazard ratios that apply. r0 is set so that the mean risk in the reference population equals the regimen rate. Regimens with risk_factors false get the regimen rate for every patient.

trastuzumab_deruxtecan.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, adjudicated drug-related

chemotherapy_single_agent.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, physician's choice arm; the risk factors were found for trastuzumab deruxtecan and are not applied

reference_population.description: Share of patients with each risk factor, used to set r0. Factors are treated as independent.
reference_population.basis: Powell et al. (2022), Table 2 and Figure 2B: 754 of 1150 under 65, 81 of 1150 with lung comorbidity, 458 and 196 of 1124 with mild and moderate or severe renal decrease, 403 of 1027 more than 4 years since diagnosis, 57 of 1137 with SpO2 below 95%

thresholds.basis: Powell et al. (2022), Figure 2B: the cut-offs of the published risk factors

grade2plus_share.basis: Modi et al. (2022): 32 of 45 events of grade 2 or higher; assumed to be the same for all patients. The eight pooled studies in Swain et al. (2022) give 99 of 139.

categories.basis: assumption; 0.15 is close to the 15.4% incidence in Powell et al. (2022)

onset_days.basis: log-normal onset time. Median from Modi et al. (2022); sigma chosen so that 87% of the events start within 12 months, as in Powell et al. (2022). Swain et al. (2022) report a median of 5.5 months in eight pooled studies and 97% within 12 months in patients with breast cancer.

neutropenia.description: Candidate 3. Neutropenia of grade 3 or higher or febrile neutropenia within 90 days. Logistic model with the patient factors of Lyman et al. (2011). The log-odds of the reference patient are set so that the mean risk in the reference population equals the regimen rate. The reference patient has none of the yes-or-no factors and the reference values of renal function and white cells.

nalirifox.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3: neutropenia 14% and decreased neutrophil count 10% of grade 3 or 4

gemcitabine_nab_paclitaxel.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3: neutropenia 25% and decreased neutrophil count 14% of grade 3 or 4

adt_docetaxel.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS, placebo arm: neutropenia 34.2% and febrile neutropenia 7.4% of grade 3 or 4, combined as independent

adt_docetaxel_abiraterone.source: Fizazi et al. (2022), PEACE-1: severe neutropenia in 10% of the patients on abiraterone and docetaxel

adt_docetaxel_darolutamide.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS: neutropenia 33.7% and febrile neutropenia 7.8% of grade 3 or 4, combined as independent

chemotherapy_single_agent.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, physician's choice arm

sacituzumab_govitecan.source: Bardia et al. (2021), ASCENT: neutropenia 51% and febrile neutropenia 6% of grade 3 or 4, combined as independent

neutropenia.regimen_shares_basis: Shares of the trial patients with earlier chemotherapy, G-CSF prophylaxis and an age of 65 or older, used to set the risk of the reference patient. Earlier chemotherapy follows the inclusion criteria of the trials. The age shares are assumptions from the median ages of the trials. The G-CSF shares are assumptions; in PEACE-1 G-CSF was first recommended and later mandatory (Fizazi et al., 2022).

prior_chemotherapy.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle

age_65_or_older.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle; 95% confidence interval 0.96 to 1.75

ast_above_35.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle; 95% confidence interval 0.99 to 2.04

alkaline_phosphatase_above_120.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle

bilirubin_above_normal.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle, bilirubin above 1 mg/dl, taken as above the upper limit of normal

per_ml_min_of_egfr.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle

per_10e9_l_of_white_cells.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle

immunosuppressive_medication.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle

reduced_starting_dose.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle: 2.018 for a planned relative dose intensity of 85% or more, inverted

gcsf_prophylaxis.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 3, multivariable model for severe or febrile neutropenia in the first cycle, primary prophylaxis with a colony-stimulating factor

ugt1a1_28_homozygous_with_irinotecan.basis: the size is an assumption; Bardia et al. (2021) and Gennari et al. (2021) report the higher risk for sacituzumab govitecan, which releases SN-38, the active form of irinotecan, and the same factor is applied to regimens with irinotecan

thresholds.basis: Lyman et al. (2011); bilirubin above 1 mg/dl is taken as above the upper limit of normal

reference_population.description: Share of patients with each factor, used to set the risk of the reference patient. Factors are treated as independent; renal function and white cells are taken at their reference values. Earlier chemotherapy, G-CSF and age come from the regimen entry. All trial patients are taken to start at the full dose.
reference_population.basis: Lyman et al. (2011), Table 1; UGT1A1 is an assumption. On a regimen with a corticosteroid every patient counts as taking immunosuppressive medication.

categories.basis: assumption; 0.1 is the cut-off between low and high risk in Lyman et al. (2011), 0.2 the risk of febrile neutropenia from which guidelines recommend primary G-CSF prophylaxis, as cited there

diarrhoea.description: Candidate 4. Diarrhoea of grade 3 or higher within 90 days. Logistic model. The log-odds of the reference patient are set so that the mean risk in the reference population equals the regimen rate. The references name the risk factors but give no effect sizes.

low_albumin.basis: assumption; albumin changes the clearance of antibody-drug conjugates (Tarantino et al., 2023) and stands for the nutritional state, which predicted non-haematological toxicity in Extermann et al. (2012)

ugt1a1_28_homozygous_with_irinotecan.basis: the size is an assumption; Bardia et al. (2021) and Gennari et al. (2021) report the higher risk for sacituzumab govitecan, which releases SN-38, the active form of irinotecan, and the same factor is applied to regimens with irinotecan

thresholds.basis: assumption; 35 g/l is the albumin threshold among the prognostic factors in Conroy et al. (2023)

reference_population.description: Share of patients with each factor, used to set the risk of the reference patient. Factors are treated as independent.
reference_population.basis: assumption; NAPOLI 3 enrolled patients with ECOG 0 or 1

categories.basis: assumption; 0.2 is the rate with NALIRIFOX, 0.1 the rate with sacituzumab govitecan

cardiovascular.description: Candidate 5. Major adverse cardiovascular events (myocardial infarction, stroke, cardiovascular death) under androgen deprivation for prostate cancer. Proportional hazards model: risk = 1 - (1 - r0)^HR, with r0 the risk of a man of the reference age without risk factors on the same type of androgen deprivation and HR the product of the hazard ratios that apply. r0 is set so that the mean risk in the reference population equals the published rate of that type.

gnrh_agonist.source: Shore et al. (2020), HERO, leuprolide arm, 19 of 308 within 48 weeks

gnrh_antagonist.source: Shore et al. (2020), HERO, relugolix arm, 18 of 622 within 48 weeks

cardiovascular.rate_note: HERO counted non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke and death from any cause. cardiovascular_share_of_events brings the rates to cardiovascular events.

cardiovascular_share_of_events.basis: Lopes et al. (2021), PRONOUNCE: 16 of the 26 men with death from any cause, myocardial infarction or stroke had cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction or stroke

gnrh_agonist.basis: Events within 48 weeks in 19 of 314 men with an earlier event (8 of 45 in HERO, Shore et al., 2020; 11 of 269 in PRONOUNCE, Lopes et al., 2021) and in 11 of 263 without (HERO); ratio of the cumulative hazards. HERO alone gives 4.57.

gnrh_antagonist.basis: Events within 48 weeks in 18 of 359 men with an earlier event (3 of 84 in HERO, Shore et al., 2020; 15 of 275 in PRONOUNCE, Lopes et al., 2021) and in 15 of 538 without (HERO); ratio of the cumulative hazards. HERO alone gives 1.29.

cardiovascular.prior_event_note: All men in PRONOUNCE had atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and are counted as men with an earlier event. They were under the care of a cardiologist.

per_10_years_of_age.basis: assumption; the ESC guideline names higher age as a risk factor (Lyon et al., 2022)

diabetes.basis: assumption; risk factor named in the ESC guideline (Lyon et al., 2022)

arterial_hypertension.basis: assumption; risk factor named in the ESC guideline (Lyon et al., 2022)

current_smoker.basis: assumption; risk factor named in the ESC guideline (Lyon et al., 2022)

renal_moderate_severe_decrease.basis: assumption; risk factor named in the ESC guideline (Lyon et al., 2022)

reference_patient.basis: median age in HERO (Shore et al., 2020)

reference_population.description: Share of patients with each risk factor, used to set r0. Factors are treated as independent, and all patients as being of the reference age.
reference_population.basis: earlier event: Shore et al. (2020), Table 1, 45 of 308 and 84 of 622. Diabetes and hypertension: 16% and 45% in a cohort of 2492 men with prostate cancer, as reported by Lopes et al. (2021); the same cohort had cardiovascular disease in 22%, which leaves about 8% without an earlier event. Smoking: 15.1% current and 38.8% former smokers in PRONOUNCE (Lopes et al., 2021). Renal function is an assumption.

lung_detection.description: Detection model for lung toxicity on weekly home measurements, see detect.py. An alert means: examine the patient. Values in points of oxygen saturation and in levels of the symptom scale from 0 to 4.
lung_detection.basis: Swain et al. (2022): an expert panel recommends an examination after a fall of the oxygen saturation at rest by 2 to 4 points over 1 to 3 days. The confirmation by a second report or by symptoms, and the size of the symptom rise, are assumptions for weekly reports.
